llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must capture scroll offset with Reanimated `useAnimatedScrollHandler(...)` attached to `Animated.ScrollView onScroll`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedScrollHandler captures contentOffset.y into scrollY shared value; the handler is passed to Animated.ScrollView onScroll prop.
evidence: const scrollHandler = useAnimatedScrollHandler({ onScroll: (event) => { scrollY.value = event.contentOffset.y } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compute header visuals in `useAnimatedStyle` using `interpolate(...)` from the shared scroll value (for example height and/or opacity).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: headerAnimatedStyle uses useAnimatedStyle with interpolate on scrollY.value to compute height; subtitleAnimatedStyle also interpolates opacity from scrollY.value.
evidence: const headerAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => { const height = interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE], [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT], Extrapolation.CLAMP) return { height } })
const subtitleAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => { const opacity = interpolate(scrollY.value, ...) })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Interpolation for header collapse must use clamped extrapolation (`Extrapolation.CLAMP`) with explicit input/output ranges.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: All interpolate calls for header collapse use explicit [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE] input ranges with corresponding output ranges and Extrapolation.CLAMP as the fourth argument.
